name: Organic Bananas
description: Sweet and perfectly ripe organic bananas. Rich in potassium and natural energy. Great for smoothies, baking, or a quick healthy snack.

name: Fresh Strawberries
description: Juicy, hand-picked strawberries bursting with flavor. Perfect for desserts, salads, or eating fresh. Packed with vitamin C.

name: Honeycrisp Apples
description: Crispy, sweet, and tangy Honeycrisp apples. A premium variety perfect for snacking, baking, or fresh salads.

name: Ripe Avocados
description: Creamy Hass avocados, perfectly ripe and ready to eat. Ideal for guacamole, toast, salads, or smoothies.

name: Fresh Blueberries
description: Plump, antioxidant-rich blueberries. Excellent for breakfast bowls, muffins, pancakes, or eating by the handful.

name: Baby Spinach
description: Tender baby spinach leaves, triple-washed and ready to eat. Perfect for salads, smoothies, or sautéing.

name: Roma Tomatoes
description: Firm, flavorful Roma tomatoes ideal for sauces, salads, and sandwiches. Vine-ripened for peak taste.

name: Sweet Bell Peppers
description: A vibrant mix of red, yellow, and green bell peppers. Crunchy, sweet, and perfect for stir-fries or salads.

name: Fresh Broccoli
description: Crisp, dark green broccoli crowns packed with vitamins. Excellent steamed, roasted, or in stir-fries.

name: Organic Carrots
description: Sweet and crunchy organic carrots. Great for snacking, juicing, roasting, or adding to soups and stews.

name: Whole Milk
description: Farm-fresh whole milk with a rich, creamy taste. Excellent for drinking, cereal, cooking, and baking.

name: Greek Yogurt
description: Thick, creamy Greek yogurt with high protein. Perfect for breakfast, smoothies, or as a cooking ingredient.

name: Cheddar Cheese
description: Aged sharp cheddar cheese with a bold, tangy flavor. Perfect for sandwiches, burgers, mac and cheese, or snacking.

name: Fresh Eggs
description: Farm-fresh free-range eggs with rich golden yolks. Essential for breakfast, baking, and everyday cooking.

name: Salted Butter
description: Creamy, European-style salted butter made from fresh cream. Perfect for cooking, baking, and spreading.

name: Sourdough Bread
description: Artisan sourdough bread with a crispy crust and tangy, chewy interior. Naturally fermented for 24 hours.

name: Croissants
description: Buttery, flaky French croissants baked fresh daily. Light, golden layers that melt in your mouth.

name: Whole Wheat Bread
description: Nutritious whole wheat bread made with 100% whole grain flour. Soft texture with a wholesome nutty flavor.

name: Chocolate Muffins
description: Rich, moist double chocolate muffins loaded with chocolate chips. A perfect treat for breakfast or snacking.

name: Bagels
description: Classic New York-style bagels with a chewy interior and golden crust. Perfect with cream cheese or as a sandwich base.

name: Orange Juice
description: Freshly squeezed, not-from-concentrate orange juice. Bursting with natural vitamin C and citrus flavor.

name: Cold Brew Coffee
description: Smooth, bold cold brew coffee steeped for 18 hours. Low acidity with a rich, chocolatey finish.

name: Green Tea
description: Premium Japanese green tea bags. Delicate, refreshing flavor packed with antioxidants. 20 bags per box.

name: Sparkling Water
description: Crisp, effervescent natural sparkling water. Zero calories, zero sweeteners. Perfectly refreshing.

name: Almond Milk
description: Unsweetened almond milk made from California almonds. Creamy, dairy-free alternative for drinking or cooking.

name: Mixed Nuts
description: Premium roasted and salted mixed nuts: almonds, cashews, pecans, and walnuts. High in protein and healthy fats.

name: Dark Chocolate Bar
description: 72% cacao dark chocolate crafted from single-origin cocoa beans. Rich, smooth, and bittersweet perfection.

name: Granola Bars
description: Crunchy oat and honey granola bars with dark chocolate chips. A nutritious, on-the-go snack. 6 bars per box.

name: Tortilla Chips
description: Stone-ground yellow corn tortilla chips. Perfectly crispy and lightly salted. Great with salsa or guacamole.

name: Trail Mix
description: A hearty blend of nuts, dried cranberries, raisins, and dark chocolate chips. Perfect for hiking or snacking.

name: Hummus
description: Classic chickpea hummus blended with tahini, lemon, and garlic. Creamy dip perfect with veggies or pita.
